tip.confidence: How certain is this state? High = multiple data sources agree; Medium = derived from partial signals; Low = inferred from stale or indirect data.
tip.cost: Estimated cost based on token pricing for the current model. Calculated from actual input/output token consumption.
tip.latency: Latest completed turn latency. First token is time until the assistant starts responding; Full turn is total turn duration including tools, tests, and deploys.
tip.projects: Ranked by output tokens per project in the selected period.
tip.pricing: Claude entries and custom Codex keys match model names by prefix. Built-in Codex keys match only exact IDs or dated snapshots, even with edited rates. Unmatched models retain token usage without a cost estimate.
tip.threshold: The context level at which the agent should start a new session to avoid degraded performance. Recommended: 200K context → 70%, 1M context → ≤40%.
